capabilities: Display per-heading word counts for H1-H6 in an outline panel
Count CJK characters one-by-one and Latin text by words
Configure counting scope, punctuation, code exclusion and heading depth
Jump to a heading in the note by clicking it in the panel
Auto-scroll marked notes to the end when opened
extras: The README includes a full Chinese-language section, and the plugin ships a bilingual interface; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's word counting gives a note-wide total and treats mixed Chinese/English text poorly, so writers cannot see how long each section is at a glance.
summary: Sidebar outline panel that shows a word count under every H1-H6 heading, counting CJK characters individually and Latin text by words.
